title: RSI overbought/oversold + doji reversal pattern, multi-group martingale grid
entry_long: RSI<30(oversold) AND ID2 bearish doji with long lower wick (lower wick>upper wick>body) AND ID1 bullish candle whose low >= ID2 low
entry_short: mirror: RSI>70(overbought) AND ID2 bullish doji with long upper wick AND ID1 bearish candle whose high <= ID2 high
exit: trailing stop 60/step1 (group-of-trade) once 2+ orders open; grid martingale add every 60 pips, step-5 +0.01 lot; close basket at $5 profit
escalation_cap: 0.1 lot (Upper Limit lot size safety clamp); no explicit order-count cap
buildon_idea: already has a soft lot clamp via Upper Limit param; add explicit max-step cap on the recovery martingale (like sibling EX157's Max Order=50) and run a flat-lot test to confirm the doji+RSI entry has real edge before scaling
novelty_note: doji reversal + RSI OB/OS combined with FTB/RTB grid-martingale recovery; fairly common fxDreema pattern, low-med novelty

title: RSI + auto-generated trendline breakout with ATR-adaptive trailing stop
entry_long: price breaks above auto-generated uptrend line (90 vs 45 candle high lookback) AND RSI oversold(<30) at the break; trend-following toggle can bias to buy-only
entry_short: mirror: price breaks below auto-generated downtrend line (90 vs 45 candle low lookback) AND RSI overbought(>70) at the break
exit: ATR-adaptive trailing stop (base 100 pips, widens with ATR up to ~400-500 pips in high volatility); grid martingale recovery every 100 pips, step-5 +0.01 lot, close basket via proportional money formula, hard cap Max Order 50
escalation_cap: Max Order 50 (recovery mode hard cap); Upper Limit lot 0.1
buildon_idea: capped at 50 orders already; test flat-lot entry-only edge, and try with-trend-only mode (buy-mode/sell-mode toggle) as author showed it massively improved results (~600% vs baseline in a 5-month trend test)
novelty_note: auto-generated dynamic trendline via highest/lowest of 90 vs 45 candle lookback is a distinctive mechanism; RSI dual-role (strict filter vs loosened pass-through) is tunable

title: Advanced RSI + auto trendline breakout (tighter variant, gold M1)
entry_long: candle close crosses above auto-generated trendline (TR_LINE_buy, 90 vs 45 candle lookback) AND RSI(7)<30 at the cross
entry_short: candle close crosses below TR_LINE_sell AND RSI(7)>70 at the cross
exit: trailing stop 100 pips; grid martingale recovery every 100 pips, +0.01 lot per add, close basket at $3 profit
escalation_cap: none stated (only an optional Volume Upper Limit is recommended, not enforced in this build)
buildon_idea: add an explicit max-order cap (missing here, unlike the sibling EX157 video which has Max Order=50); flat-lot test the entry edge; author states params are untuned so there is room to optimize RSI zones
novelty_note: near-duplicate of the sibling EX157 trendline-breakout build but an M1 gold variant with a tighter grid (100 pips) and lower close-money ($3); same core mechanism, low incremental novelty

title: EMA3/8 cross + Stochastic OB/OS + price-distance filter, RSI-zone-scaled martingale grid
entry_long: Stochastic<30(oversold) AND EMA_fast(3) crosses above EMA_slow(8) AND price-to-EMA_fast distance <=300 pips
entry_short: Stochastic>70(overbought) AND EMA_fast crosses below EMA_slow AND price-to-EMA_fast distance <=300 pips
exit: trailing stop 60/step1 (group-of-trade) once 2+ orders open; grid recovery every 60 pips, lot sized by RSI(7) zone at each add (RSI in OB/OS zone -> +0.01 lot increase, RSI in mid-high 51-69 zone -> flat 0.01 lot); close basket at $5 combining both groups
escalation_cap: 0.1 lot (Upper Limit lot size); no explicit order-count cap
buildon_idea: RSI-zone-gated lot scaling already reduces blind martingale; add a hard max-order cap; test flat-lot for the base entry edge; author showed switching TF from 5min to 15min cut max DD from 44% to 11% at roughly half the profit — worth exploring intermediate TFs
novelty_note: RSI-zone-conditional lot increment during recovery (vs a flat step) is a nice refinement over plain martingale; the price-distance filter (don't chase price) is also notable

title: Multi-timeframe RSI(H1) + Stochastic cross + EMA200 trend filter, single-shot with equity cut-loss
entry_long: RSI(H1)<30 AND Stochastic main crosses above signal in oversold zone(<20) on current TF AND EMA_fast(3)>EMA(200)
entry_short: RSI(H1)>70 AND Stochastic main crosses below signal in overbought zone(>80) AND EMA_fast(3)<EMA(200)
exit: no fixed TP; martingale add every 100 pips against the position (+0.01 lot per add, no step cap), take profit at $5 basket; hard cut-loss at -$1000 equity closes all and resets
escalation_cap: none for lot size (only an overall -$1000 equity cut-loss safety net, not a per-lot cap)
buildon_idea: add an explicit step/order cap on the martingale ladder rather than relying solely on the $1000 cut-loss; author demonstrated a loosened-RSI variant (OB/OS swapped to 70/30) trading ~20k orders over 3 years with 30+ cut-loss events — worth testing whether the tighter default RSI filter alone is sufficient without needing the cut-loss safety net
novelty_note: combining a higher-TF RSI filter with current-TF Stochastic cross + EMA200 trend alignment is a reasonably rich multi-factor filter; hard equity cut-loss instead of per-trade SL is a notable risk-design choice

title: Stochastic(9,3,3) cross in OB/OS zone + EMA3/50 filter + manual trend-mode toggle, martingale grid
entry_long: Stochastic main crosses above signal within oversold zone(<30, tunable to 20) AND EMA_fast(3)>EMA_slow(50) AND buy-mode manually enabled
entry_short: Stochastic main crosses below signal within overbought zone(>70, tunable to 80) AND EMA_fast(3)<EMA_slow(50) AND sell-mode manually enabled
exit: trailing stop 10/step1 (group-of-trade) once 2+ orders open; grid martingale every 15 pips, step-4 +0.01 lot; close basket at 5 pips profit; optional safe-mode force-closes on adverse price impulse (10 pips within 10s) or when order count exceeds 30
buildon_idea: the safe-mode impulse-protection + 30-order cap is a good template to reuse elsewhere; test with safe-mode always-on; author notes the manual buy/sell-mode trend toggle greatly improved 5-year results (~250% gain) — could automate the trend detection instead of a manual toggle
novelty_note: impulse-detection safety block (10-pip move within 10s triggers emergency close) is a distinctive protective mechanism worth cataloging separately from the martingale core

title: EMA3/8 cross + 3-candle reversal confirmation, fixed SL/TP500 with opposite pending-order hedge
entry_long: EMA3 crosses above EMA8 at candle ID1, with ID3 bearish, ID2 bearish, ID1 bullish confirmation candle
entry_short: EMA3 crosses below EMA8 at candle ID1, with ID3 bullish, ID2 bullish, ID1 bearish confirmation candle
exit: fixed SL 500 pips / TP 500 pips; on entry simultaneously opens an opposite-direction pending stop order (offset 500 pips, lot 0.02 = double) as a single-shot hedge; whichever side hits TP closes and deletes the other pending order
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed lot, single hedge shot; author explicitly states no martingale)
buildon_idea: already a clean fixed-risk structure (SL/TP capped, single hedge shot); build-on: add break-even/trailing management (see the revised sibling EX160 xJBwiW20qt0) or expand symbol/TF coverage since the risk is bounded
novelty_note: single-shot opposite pending-order hedge (losing side pre-arms a stop order; winner cancels the loser's pending order) instead of martingale recovery is a distinct, safer mechanism

title: EMA3/8 cross + 3-candle reversal, opposite pending-order hedge (HG) with rebate-lot tracking
entry_long: EMA3 crosses above EMA8 with ID3 bearish, ID2 bearish, ID1 bullish confirmation candle
entry_short: EMA3 crosses below EMA8 with ID3 bullish, ID2 bullish, ID1 bearish confirmation candle
exit: fixed SL500/TP500; opens a single opposite-direction pending hedge order (offset 500 pips, lot 0.02) same mechanism as sibling video; tracks total closed lots for rebate calculation
buildon_idea: near-duplicate of sibling EX160(msnxjMFbI8Y) build; use as a base for testing across more symbol/TF pairs since the fixed-risk hedge structure is inherently safer; combine with the break-even revision (EX160 xJBwiW20qt0) for improved efficiency
novelty_note: essentially the same mechanism as EX160_msnxjMFbI8Y (single opposite pending-order hedge); near-duplicate video content, low incremental novelty

title: EMA3/8+3-candle pending-hedge system revised: adds break-even-point stop management
entry_long: same EMA3/8 cross + 3-candle bullish reversal confirmation as the base version
entry_short: same EMA3/8 cross + 3-candle bearish reversal confirmation as the base version
exit: fixed SL500/TP500 with opposite pending-order hedge (lot 0.02, offset 500 pips) unchanged from base; ADDED: break-even-point block moves SL to entry+50 pips once price reaches 400 pips profit, locking in a minimum 50-pip gain instead of risking a full round-trip back to loss
buildon_idea: author's own before/after comparison shows this revision improved results (lower max DD, higher turnover) over the base version with only 4 added blocks — strong candidate to adopt as the default over the unrevised sibling; test across a wider symbol/TF set
novelty_note: break-even-point risk-management addition to the pending-hedge system; incremental but validated improvement (author shows explicit before/after backtest: 2023-24 gold M5, profit 52.9%, maxDD 15.6%)

title: Stochastic OB/OS + spinning-top candlestick reversal, money-based trailing stop, fixed-lot grid add
entry_long: ID3,ID2 bearish trend candles, ID1 is a doji/spinning-top with lower wick > upper wick > body (bullish rejection), AND Stochastic<20(oversold) at ID1
entry_short: ID3,ID2 bullish trend candles, ID1 is a spinning-top doji with upper wick > lower wick > body (bearish rejection), AND Stochastic>80(overbought) at ID1
exit: trailing money-loss stop (soft SL/trail set at $50 loss, trails up with profit); grid add every 200 pips in the favorable direction at a fixed +0.01 lot (not escalating); manual buy-mode/sell-mode trend toggle recommended for efficiency
escalation_cap: unspecified order-count cap (Upper Limit lot 0.1 safety clamp only); loss bounded via $50 trailing-money-loss stop per side
buildon_idea: already linear-add (not martingale) with a soft $50 money-stop; add an explicit max-add-count cap and test a flat single-shot entry to isolate the spinning-top+stochastic edge from the grid-add layer; author notes manual H1-trend-based buy/sell-mode selection substantially improves results — could automate that trend filter
novelty_note: spinning-top 3-candle pattern (wick-ratio doji reversal) combined with Stochastic OB/OS zone is a reasonably distinct candlestick+oscillator confluence; money-based trailing stop instead of pip-based is a minor variant
